versions.changelog:
- Added a "Start on APIDot" section with direct entry points for new users, improving onboarding guidance.
- No longer includes the skill-card.md file.
- All previous integration, security, and workflow guidance retained and unchanged.
- Documentation structure improved with clearer navigation for ClawHub users.

- Added non-executable API and workflow notes in references/api.md for easier reference.
- Removed skill-card.md to streamline documentation and avoid redundancy.
- Updated SKILL.md to reference local notes in references/api.md and clarify its documentation-only scope.
- No executable, install-time, or automation files included in this release.

Initial release of documentation-only skill for APIDot Happy Horse API workflows.

- Provides comprehensive guidance for integrating Alibaba Happy Horse video generation features via APIDot.
- Covers supported workflows: text-to-video, image-to-video, reference-to-video, video editing, async task handling, polling, and webhooks.
- Details strong security practices for API keys and sensitive data.
- Includes direct model routing, official docs and example links, and clear workflow instructions.
- No scripts or code included; this release is reference documentation only.
